speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see a newborn with a generalized rash; to help me understand the cause, how old is the baby and when did the rash first appear?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Disease (Disseminated Gonococcal Infection).

Based on the history of maternal gonorrhea and the acute onset of a generalized rash in a 4-day-old, I am ordering a Gram stain and Culture of the blood and skin lesions to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Blood Culture, Skin Lesion Gram_Stain and Culture.
